name: annoto-kaltura-configurator
description: Local web tool to configure a Kaltura V7 player (uiConf) so it auto-loads the Annoto plugin — sets confVars.versions (playkit-annoto-loader) and the annoto-loader config, via the Kaltura API.

scripts.build:win: node buildtools/embed-html.js && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 buildtools/entry.cjs --outfile dist/AnnotoConfigurator.exe
